reason: Fig. 8 is the plan of trench RGP-4, about 9 m by 5 m, with mud-brick walls, rooms and post-holes of a trench excavated in 1953-56 and long backfilled. It draws no surviving feature. The only chain is through the site plan (Plate I), where RGP-4 is a plain rectangle about 30 by 20 px at 300 dpi (8 by 6 m) drawn with a pen about 4 px wide, while Fig. 8 draws an irregular dashed trench outline; their corners cannot be put in correspondence within the 2 m class P error.

candidates_considered.feature: walls, rooms, drain, platform and post-holes inside RGP-4

trench limits do not survive in the imagery
